Hi Carter / team — thanks, I handled the calculation and attached an updated invoice + working sheet. Summary below.

Policy and approach:
- We bill on a calendar-month cycle. Mid-month seat increases are billed pro-rata for the remainder of that calendar month and then the full monthly rate thereafter.
- For EU B2B customers with a valid VAT ID we apply reverse-charge (no VAT on the invoice) and include the customer's VAT number and a note referencing the B2B reverse charge rule.

Proration calculation (May 2026):
- Previous seats: 10
- New seats: 18
- Increase: 8 seats
- Monthly price per seat (contracted): €140.00
- May has 31 days; increase effective 2026-05-06. We bill for the remainder of May starting 2026-05-06 inclusive (31 - 5 = 26 days).
- Proration factor: 26 / 31 = 0.838709
- Prorated charge = 8 seats * €140.00 * 0.838709 = €939.35 (rounded to 2 decimals)

Invoice details I generated:
- Invoice: Redwood-INV-20260513-14872 (attached PDF)
- Net prorated charge: €939.35
- VAT: 0% (reverse-charge). Please confirm BlueWave's VAT ID so we can populate the invoice. If we do not receive a valid VAT ID we will default to charging applicable local VAT and reissue the invoice.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date (2026-05-13).

I attached: Redwood-INV-20260513-14872.pdf (invoice stub showing line items and reverse-charge note) and proration_workbook_May2026.xlsx (calculation workbook with day count and rounding).

If you'd prefer we apply a credit on your next renewal invoice instead of issuing an immediate pro-rated invoice, let me know and we can do that as an alternative; however since you asked for documentation for your AP run this week I issued the invoice today.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want me to walk through the calc.
